package.description: Simple, powerful and privacy-friendly AI chat application for GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and other LLMs.

en-US.description: Simple, powerful and privacy-friendly AI chat application for GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and other LLMs.
en-US.longDescription: ChatWise is a desktop AI chat application that supports any large language model, including GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and Llama. Connect directly with your own API keys or use existing subscriptions such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Pro/Max. It renders HTML, React, charts and documents as artifacts, searches the web through Tavily or local browsers, connects to external tools with MCP, and stores all data locally on your device.
en-US.name: ChatWise

zh-CN.description: ChatWise 是一款简洁、强大且注重隐私的 AI 聊天应用，支持 GPT-4、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek 等大语言模型。
zh-CN.longDescription: ChatWise 是一款桌面 AI 聊天应用，支持任意大语言模型，包括 GPT-4、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek 和 Llama。可以直接使用自己的 API 密钥连接模型服务商，也可以使用 GitHub Copilot、Claude Pro/Max 等现有订阅。它支持以 Artifacts 形式渲染 HTML、React、图表和文档，可通过 Tavily 或本地浏览器搜索网页，借助 MCP 连接外部工具，并將所有数据保存在本地设备上。
